events.title: Gold Coast Eisteddfod
events.datetime: Mon 20 Jul – Sun 26 Jul, 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM
events.location: Various venues across Surfers Paradise and the Gold Coast
events.description: The Gold Coast Eisteddfod is a multi-day competitive festival showcasing performances in various genres of music, dance, and drama across multiple venues, attracting local talent and audiences.
